verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a reasonable capability for a sales-tax compliance SaaS, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The only AI-related evidence is a docs-only MCP server for external AI coding assistants, which never proxies calls to the API. That is an adjacent developer integration, not a built-in assistant, and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
